title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.35

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P=infinity for z=1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins (modelled 0.438: main phase >= 1 - 2^-192 over the Wiedemann projections, both boots fail with probability <= 1.8e-4, Markov bound 2^-0.901 at the 2^119.5-unit descent cap, special-q repeats <= 2^-5.24), under the NFS heuristics H1-H5 of proof.md section 9. A global meter bounds all classical work, including preprocessing, failures, transfers, verification and output, by W <= 2^122.35 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.329691: relation collection 2^121.8409, linear algebra 2^119.5608, generator 2^106.16, descent cap 2^119.5 with expected two-log work 2^118.599, and smaller terms. Distributed storage is at most 2^105 bytes in bounded, explicitly addressed objects. Nothing is amortized across challenges; no advice or auxiliary powers are used. This is an analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
